batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b RJ Harris

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c PP Ojha b R Sharma

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c A Symonds b RP Singh

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c J Theron b IK Pathan

batting.name: TL Suman
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b PP Chawla

batting.name: MR Marsh
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b Yuvraj Singh

balls.text: another full ball, outside off, squeezed towards sweeper cover for a single, Punjab finish on 174
a full delivery just outside off, Yuvraj powers that one towards long-on, ends as a simple catch for Symonds, Yuvraj hasn't crossed over which means the new batsman will take strike
Jayawrdene's chance of making a century are nearly over, he guides this one towards midwicket for a single
what a shot that is, slugged over long-on and Jayawardene moves into the 90s,that was a half-volley from RP
gets that away towards backward point for two more
a thick outside edge races away to the third man boundary
slogged to long-on, Symonds fields and throws to Harris, Jayawradene was struggling to get back for the second but Harris misses as he flicks the ball at the stumps
tapped to extra cover for a single
gets on one knee and opens the face to guide the ball to the third man boundary this time
Harris is appealing for lbw, Jayawardene moves to the off side, and delicately glides the ball for four to fine leg
a yorker that is dug out towards third man for a single
a flat, powerful hit from Yuvraj, short ball, absolutely hammered over midwicket

droppedm but that was a tough chance, Jayawardene hits it very high towards long-on, that was in the air a long time, RP had to make plenty of ground towards the circle, he misjudges it a touch and dives at the last moment but can't take the catch
superb fielding from Sumanth at long-off, Jayawardene had clobbered a full delivery and Sumanth had to throw himself full-length to his left to stop that
Yuvraj gets this full ball towards deep square leg
the power of Yuvraj on display, it was a low full toss from Marsh, Yuvraj clubs it past wide long-on for four
fires in the yorker, Yuvraj can only block it back to the bowler
Yuvraj looks for the booming hit over long-on, but misses the ball, it was length and outside off
make that five fours in a row, it was a good delivery form RP this time, a yorker just outside off, Jayawardene squeezes it past Rahul Sharma at short fine for a boundary
Jayawardene on fire, short ball and wide, batsman stands tall and whacks it over extra cover for another boundary
RP serves up a full toss this time, Jayawardene doesn't time it too well but there's enough power to get it to the wide long-on boundary
full and outside off, Jayawardene gets back-to-back boundaries, driven over point this time, that was a half-volley
innovative from Jayawardene, short ball outside off, MJ uppercuts it over backward point for four to bring up his half-century
short and wide, chopped towards point
RP starts out with a delivery way outside off stump
chance there, blasted back towards the bowler, who had to jump to take a return catch, gets a hand on it but can't hang on, the ball is deflected towards mid-on
smashed towards sweeper cover, Ryan Harris gets across in time but can't collect the ball cleanly, the ball rolls over the rope
a much-needed six for Punajab, converts the ball into a full toss by charging down the track and hammers it straight for a six
full ball just outside off, powerfully hit to mid-off, no run though as its straight at the fielder
short and very wide, Yuvraj can't capitalise, he can only drive it towards extra cover
short and down the legside, poor delivery that in the middle of a good spell
full ball, Jayawardene clubs it down the ground, long-on fields
Jayawardene backs away this time, no room for him, he manages to cut the ball past backward point
yet another single, a full delivery is driven down the ground by Yuvraj
again Jayawardene walks way across the offstump, Marsh keeps the ball well outside off, batsman get it away to square leg
full and just outside off, driven towards cover by Yuvraj
short and a bit of width, Jayawardene slugs it towards sweeper cover, just a single
short of length, Yuvraj moves away to make room and glides the ball towards short third man
length ball pitching outside off, watchfully defended off the front foot
gets a single this time, clipped towards short midwicket
much fuller, Jayawardene gets forward and strikes it powerfully to mid-off
poor delivery, very short, Yuvraj has plenty of time to swipe that to midwicket and get his first run
moves way across off and looks to swing that to square leg, is struck on the pads just outside off
angling into the pads, Jayawardene can't get it away
another ripper to end the over, just short of a length, in the corridor, Yuvraj tries to defend but is beaten outside off
back of a length and angling across the batsman who plays it behind square on the off, still not off the mark
makes some room and carves that ball towards deep backward square leg for a single
super spell for Deccan here, Punjab haven't scored in eight deliveries now, this was a length ball on off, tapped back to the bowler
great delivery there, seaming away after pitching just outside off, Jayawardene is beaten as he wafts at it
length ball on off, Jayawardene whips it towards mid-on, smartly fielded there
Yuvraj looks to sweep, but is struck on the pads outside legstump, great over that
Yuvraj looks to swing that to midwicket, but that was a quicker one without much room for the batsman, 102kmh
gets forward and blocks it back to the bowler
Yuvraj looks to defend his first ball but the extra bounce troubles him, can't get bat on it, there's a big lbw appeal but that was too high
outside leg, Sangakkara unwisely goes for the reverse-sweep, doesn't get hold of it, and the ball loops to short fine leg, Rahul Sharma has got the breakthrough
short and wide outside off, moves back and cuts to sweeper cover
full and outside off, Sangakkara brings up his half-century with a shot he wouldn't like to see again, he was looking to flat bat it down the ground but gets a top-edge past the keeper
this time Sangakkara gets it away towards midwicket, it was a fullish ball, nice hit from Sangakkara
Sangakkara looks to whack that over midwicket but inside-edges onto his pads
Sangakkara looks to cut that one, but misses, just outside off
down the leg side, swept to short fine leg
on legstump, Jayawardene again makes room, plays an inside-out lofted drive to deep extra cover
follows the batsmen as he moves away to leg, driven down to long-on, batsmen zip through for two
full toss outside leg stump, Sangakkara is hit on the pads, the ball rolls to short fine leg
on the pads again, turned to the leg side for an easy single
clipped towards midwicket for a single
on the legstump, Sangakkara gets the first six of the innings by swiping that over deep backward square leg, just clears the fielder
length ball just outside off, driven elegantly to sweeper cover
short of length outside off, played back to the bowler
good over from Ojha, Sangakkara looks to crash an outside off ball through point but misses
watchfully defended by Sangakkara
dropped, Jayawardene sweeps, Rahul Sharma has to get across to his left to latch onto a high catch at short fine lg but he puts it down
outside off, Jayawardene carves it towards backward point
down the leg side, Jayawardene moves across and hoicks it towards fine leg for a one-bounce four
on middle, defended with soft hands
fuller outside off, gets on the front foot and drives to sweeper cover

low full toss, powerfully lashed down the ground, Symonds raced across from long-off to dive and partly stop the ball, RP Singh picked up the deflection from Symonds but manages to touch the rope as he fields
full and just outside off, defended towards the bowler
short ball which doesn't get up too high, swung towards deep square leg
tossed up on middle and leg, pushed wide of mid wicket for an easy single
short and width provided, Jayawardene slaps it hard but straight towards point
a bit of width, this time Jayawardene gets it away towards deep extra cover
and again, moving away after bouncing, Jayawardene looks to defend but is beaten
superb shape there for Symonds, back of a length on off, swerves away after bouncing, Jayawardene can't do much with that
on middle and leg this time, driven down to long-on
Symonds starts with a gift on legstump, easily turned away for four towards backward square leg
angling into legstump again, Jayawardene comes down the track and flicks it towards deep square leg, bounces just wide of the man running across from long leg
length ball just outside off, Sangakkara flatbats it towards mid-off, a bit of a misfield allows the batsmen to pinch a tight single
well outside off, left alone by Sangakkara
overpitched and wide, Sangakkara says thank you and drives it over point for four
similar delivery, Sangakkara looks to drive, gets it off the toe end of the bat towards slip
back of length and well outside off, Sangakkara leaves it for the keeper
poor ball to finish the over, full and wide, Jayawardene blasts it through extra cover for four
angling into the pads, clipped towards deep square leg
nearly caught-and-bowled, full ball just outside off, Jayawardene chips it back towards the bowler, who has to jump to get his hand on it, can't hang on to it though
another short one from RP, Jayawardene gets under that one as well
what a reply from RP, superbly directed bouncer, Jayawardene just about manages to sway out of the way, exchanges a smile with Sangakkara after surviving that one
starts with a length ball outside off, Jayawardene looks to blast it over mid-off, mistimes it and the ball just about clears mid-on and runs away for four
same length on middle and off, Sangakkara backs away and hacks at it, can't beat the man at point
much better length this time, just outside off, left alone
classy from Sangakkara, to full from Marsh, just outside off, Sangakkara steps forward and plays a textbook drive past extra cover
Shot! short of a length and the bounce means the ball sits up for him outside off, Sangakkara is very strong square on the off side, he carves it for a one-bounce four
fuller this time, outside off, Sangakkara leaves it to the keeper
starts with a beauty, angling across Sangakkara, length ball, extra bounce beats Sangakkara, 131kmh
Jayawardene backs away and looks to dab it behind square on the off side, he misses and the keeper collects
short of length on the pads this time, defended towards the leg side
Harris struggling to control his line on this pitch which is offering him plenty of help, this one is down leg
short of length on the pads, tucked away towards short fine

Sangakkara charges out and towards the leg side to make room, it was full and outside off, Sangakkara gets on one knee and lofts it over cover for a boundary, he's looking a lot more comfortable than Jayawardene
extra bounce troubles Jayawardene, the batsman adjust late and looks to turn the ball towards midwicket, off the pads
down the leg side, he'll have to re-bowl that one
ooh, moves away sharply after bouncing short of a length, Jayawradene flails at it but doesn't connect, close to the edge that one
back of a length, pitching just outside off, swinging away a touch, Sangakkara happy to leave
much shorter this time, Sangakkara chops it towards backward point
fullish delivery, clipped towards midwicket for a couple
nice shape outside off, some swing for RP, pitches too far outside off to trouble the batsman though
lovely square drive for four from Sangakkara, first boundary of the day
nice start for RP, good tight line, Sangakkara pushes it towards cover
length ball on middle and leg, pushed towards midwicket for the first run of the bat

Shaun Marsh walks, that was a ripper of a delivery, just short of length and outside off, Marsh tries to defend but gets a thin edge through to the keeper, umpire Erasmus wasn't lifting his finger, but Marsh didn't wait for the verdict, extra bounce surprised the batsman there
slanting onto the pads, Jayawardene looks to tickle it down, the ball dribbles towards short fine leg
jags away after pitching short of length, Jayawardene looks to swipe that it but doesn't connect
good length again, angling into middle, blocked to the off side again
starts with a length ball on off, defended to the off side
Deccan win their fourth in a row, Sumanth slaps that one through the crowded in-fielded past cover

scores are level, Rohit Sharma has done the job for Deccan, in the slot, Rohit slams it over long-on, Chawla runs across to field, gets a hand on it as he puts in the dive but can only palm it over the rope
short slower ball, 107 kmh, Rohit waits and smashes that wide of long-on for four which makes Deccan favourites for the game
another couple for Rohit, getting it away towards wide long-on
full and wide, too wide for the umpire's liking
full delivery outside off, closer to Theron this time, a flat throw in to Irfan, Sumanth dives to complete the run, third umpire called for, batsman is just in
a good-looking stroke from Rohit, driven towards sweeper cover, wide of Theron giving time to take two
short of length on middle and off, edged onto his pads, and sort of kicks it in the process of setting off for the single
Sumnath gets off the mark by getting a single to square leg, keeper runs across to field
length ball eased down to long-on for a single

Marsh looks to repeat the shot that fetched him a six, gets it on the toe end of the bat, the ball loops to Jayawardene at long-on, another twist to this game. Yuvraj does a Gayle celebration, a poker-faced stare in celebration
a low full toss just outside off, driven down to long-off for a single
sensibly driven towards cover for a single
length ball on off, Marsh charges down the ground and wallops that over long-on for six
another offbreak from Theron, Marsh looks for the big swing, can only get it to fine leg for a single, tight over from Theron
and that's another half-century for Rohit, a low full toss on the pads again, tucked towards deep square leg
back of length, just outside off, blocked towards the off side, only a single again
full toss on the pads, Rohit will be unhappy at missing out on that one, he can only get it to Jayawardene at fine leg
full ball speared into middle and off, driven down to long-on for a single
short of length and just outside off, defended towards the off side for  a quick single
big appeal for lbw, but Marsh was hit outside the line by that straighter one
gets forward and drives it towards point
fullish ball again, Rohit gets it off the outside half of the bat, ball is the air but it lands between deep extra cover and long-off
left alone by Rohit, pitching just outside off and turning away sharply
fullish ball well outside off, driven towards cover
fullish ball driven down to long-off for a single
shortish ball outside off, Marsh looks to cut, gets a bottom edge past the keeper for four streaky runs
inside-edge onto the pads, back of a length and angling in
length ball on middle and off, defended by Marsh
another one slips down the leg side
bowled him, that's a huge breakthrough from Theron, the ball angled in after pitching short of off, Symonds made room to hit towards point, he misses and the ball crashes into middle and off
searches for the yorker again, but it slides down the leg-side to give away a free run
low full toss on middle, turned away to midwicket for a single
shortish ball angling into off, no room for Symonds, who gets it behind point for a single
Rohit looks to drive off the backfoot towards point, but is beaten by the ball just outside off
length ball on middle and off, Symonds sensibly hits it along the ground to long-off
goes on straight after pitching way outside off, left alone by Symonds
a short ball helps Symonds get his first runs, crisply hit towards wide long-on for two
flighted delivery, overpitched outside off, driven towards short cover

good catch from Sangakkara ends a superb partnership, big turn for Piyush Chawla, takes the ball well outside off, Suman looks to cut it but gets a top edge near the bottom of the bat, Sangakkara pouches the nick
finishes his spell with a full and wide ball, Rohit hits it straight to point
a yorker outside off, squeezed towards point
slower ball, low full toss, Rohit tries to hit it too hard and can only get it along the ground to long-on
length ball way outside off, Rohit manages to leans across and get enough power to send that soaring over cover for six
overpitched on middle and off, Suman looks good when he plays straight, he punches this one to long-on
full and wide, Rohit has to reach across to chop that towards sweeper cover
eased towards long-off for a single
overpitched, Rohit's inside-out drive was in the air for a bit but lands short of a diving Marsh at short cover
terrible delivery from yuvraj, way down the leg side, easily dismissed to the fine leg boundary
stretches forward as he defends that one towards mid-off
punched to mid-on for a single
Yuvraj's first ball is clobbered over midwicket, Suman gets on his knee and sends that one sailing over the rope to bring up the 100
a yorker to complete the over, dug out towards point for a single
overpitched, supremely-timed lofted drive for four, to the right of long-off
no footwork from Suman as he looks to carve a short-and-wide ball, doesn't connect
similar length, shift line towards middle, jabbed towards third man for a single
and that's the 500th six of the IPL, another short ball, pulled powerfully to midwicket again
another hit-me delivery, shortish ball on legstump, Rohit dispatches it past midwicket, one bounce for four
quicker ball, went on with the angle, inside-edged towards short fine leg
poor delivery to finish the over, short and heading down leg, swung away to the square-leg boundary, all along the ground
googly this time, driven to mid-on for a sharp single
quicker and just outside off, opens the face to guide to short third man
fuller and outside off, tapped towards cover for a single
short ball on middle, batsman backs away and crashes it towards sweeper cover
another slower ball, again 106kmh, length and on off, punched back past the bowler for a single
slower ball, 106kmh, well outside off, dabbed to third man for a single
overpitched and outside off, driven crisply towards point
low full toss this time on offstump, punched towards long-on for a single
length ball, that's bread-and-butter for Suman, a big swing of the bat sends the ball soaring over wide long-on
short of length ball, defended off the backfoot
eased towards long-on for a single by Suman
single to long-off this time, Rohit drives it along the ground
a sensible drive to cover for another single
big turn for Chawla, Suman goes for the big hit, looking to clear long-on, beaten by the spin, but somehow manages to ground his bat in time before Sangakkara whipped off the bails
Rohit cuts this one towards cover for a single

fullish ball just outside off, driven uppishly towards long-off, just lands short of Theron, he fires in the throw to the keeper as Rohit was ball-watching initially, it was a wide giving the batsman time to complete the second
length ball on offstump, pushed towards mid-on
looks to turn this one towards square leg but can't time it
short of length ball outside off, a square drive to get off the mark, lovely hit from Rohit
Vikramjeet strikes with a full ball, Mishra shuffled across the stumps looking to glance it fine, is hit on the back leg, umpire upholds appeal, but that looked to be going down leg
batsman charges out of the crease and though the ball isn't too full, he swings it over mid-off, one-bounce four
angling down leg again, hits the thigh pad and runs away fine for four leg bye
another leg-side wide from Punjab
short of length ball on off, cramps the batsman for room, he jabs it towards backward point
short of length on off, batsman cramped for run, jabs the ball towards backward point
down the leg side, and that's a free run for Deccan
angling into the pads, easily tucked to deep square leg
clubbed towards the bowler by Mishra, Theron manages to get a foot on that, deflected towards mid-on
length ball this time, just outside off, gets the outside edge, sails over the infield, wide of third man for a boundary
a yorker from Theron, inside-edged towards keeper
another short one to finish, again Suman charges down the ground and looks to swipe the ball but misses
another bouncer, these batsmen are far less comfortable when the ball is short, this one was too short though, and sails over the batsman's head
chopped towards backward point off the backfoot
a bouncer, Mishra attempts an ambitious hook, misses the ball
flat-batted off the backfoot, not great timing again, goes towards mid-on, goes for the single, Yuvraj is the fielder, direct hit would have caught the batsman way short, misses though
a mishit from Mishra, reaches the man at deep midwicket on the bounce
back of a length outside off, dabbed towards backward point
138kmh bouncer to round off the over, just outside off, batsman can't get bat on that
fuller this time, on middle and leg, mistimed towards mid-on by Suman
short ball just outside off, Suman delicately opens the face to run it down towards third man for four
shifts his line to outside off, Suman moves away from leg, mistimes it back to the bowler
length ball from Theron, heading for the pads, swung away by Suman for a superbly-timed six over midwicket
Theron starts with a full ball on offstump, driven towards square leg
short ball this time, middle stump line, batsman looks to get it away towards third man but doesn't connect
swing and a miss, short of length ball angling outside off, bowler has a word with batsman
a touch fuller, on legstump, blocked back to the bowler
short of length on middle and leg, Sumna backs away again and dabs the ball towards cover
short and wide, Suman was backing away so he couldn't reach it, harshly called a wide by the umpire
lovely hit from Suman, not too short from the bowler, just outside off, flatbatted over mid-on for a one-bounce four
superb start for Srivastava, back of a length going on to middle and off, inside-edged onto the pads
length ball just outside off again, driven towards mid-off
length ball on off, much better, punched to mid-off
easy put away for Mishra, on the pads, tickled past fine leg for four

just when I was saying he will like the pace, he is done in by one that pitches in the green area and holds up a bit. Gilchrist goes for the big shot over the keepers, and is early into the shot, and ends up skying it to extra cover
top shot, Gilchrist will love the pace of this pitch, there is swing in this ball too, but he punches it square, and it flies across the outfield
shape away from Gilchrist, starting middle and off and looking away, Gilchrist defends
back of a length, and it kicks at him, throat high, beating him on the pull
good reply to the swing, jumps out of the track, goes with the shape, opens the face, and goes over cover. Not a bad delivery but he has manufactured four
lovely outswinger, beats him outside off, misses the edge not by much
slight shape, but too leg-sidish. Mishra still gets squared up, but the ball lands well short of mid-on
short, not much width, but he packs a punch in that cut. Shaun Marsh gets a hand on it at backward point
swing, into the pads, Gilchrist is slightly overbalanced, but the mis-hit clears midwicket
